fun_facts.text: Garrett had the week's highest single-game score (72.65 FP from Alperen Sengun) AND the lowest (2.65 FP from Jamal Murray).
The Nick vs Benton matchup was decided by just 15.0 points -> the week's closest contest.
Luka Doncic scored 45+ FP in all 4 games this week -> elite consistency for Nick.
Nick's 14-4 record significantly outpaces the Pythagorean-expected 9.5-8.5--a luck index of +4.5 suggests favorable scheduling and close-game fortune have been kind this season.
The luck gap between Nick (+4.5) and Hayden (-4.4) is 8.9 wins--nearly 9 games of difference that scoring alone can't explain.
Nick's 60.9% career win rate leads the league by 9.1 percentage points over Hayden.
Benton and Nick have completed 12 trades since 2017, making them the league's most active trade partners.
